carrier_line.bell: The newest iPhone and Android phones on a monthly plan. Bell SmartPay spreads the phone's price across 24 months.
carrier_line.virgin-plus: Monthly plans, most with Member Benefits built in: perks across food, shopping, travel and entertainment that cost nothing extra.
carrier_line.lucky-mobile: Prepaid, so you pay first and use it after. Nobody checks your credit, nothing locks you in, and you're on the same Bell network.

repairs.title: Screens and glass
repairs.text: We fit a new screen or glass when yours is cracked or shattered, on phones and tablets.

repairs.title: Weak batteries
repairs.text: Your phone drains quickly, shuts down early or has a swollen battery.

repairs.title: Won't charge
repairs.text: Nothing happens when you plug it in, or it charges only when the cable is wedged at an angle.

repairs.title: Cameras and cracked backs
repairs.text: Photos coming out blurry, a lens with a crack in it, or a back panel that's smashed.

repairs.title: Sound problems
repairs.text: Calls sound muffled, or the speaker or microphone has gone quiet.

repairs.title: A wet phone
repairs.text: Power it off straight away and get it to us quickly.

faq.a: Yes. Come in {{ hours_phrase }}. Book a visit only if you'd like a time agreed in advance.

faq.q: Does my number move with me?
faq.a: Yes, your number is yours to take. Bring a recent bill that shows your account number, plus photo ID in case we need it. Keep the old plan going until the number has moved; that service then closes automatically.
It's a Bell Authorised Retailer. You can sign up here for Bell, Virgin Plus or Lucky Mobile plans and phones, and for Bell internet, TV or a home phone line.

faq.q: Do you repair tablets as well as phones?
faq.a: Yes, both. Tell us the model and what's gone wrong, and you'll have a price before we touch anything.
